description: The identity from {0,1} ordered by equality to {0,1} with numerical order is a monotone bijection. It fails to reflect 0 ≤ 1, and its inverse is not monotone.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.equality_to_linear_monotone_bijection :
  Function.Bijective id ∧
    (∀ (a b : Fin 2), a = b → id a ≤ id b) ∧ (id 0 ≤ id 1 ∧ 0 ≠ 1) ∧ ¬∀ (a b : Fin 2), a ≤ b → id a = id b
